title: 巴德·星门旅人
description: 巴德披厚重旅行袍立于星门前，面具三孔与白色鬃须清楚可辨，号角安静挂在身侧，米普在后方停驻。

art_direction.medium: angular wax-crayon strokes, directional hatching and dramatic hard-edged light on textured paper
art_direction.identity: Bard is a celestial traveler with a large pale mask showing three dark apertures, a flowing white mane and beard, short solid limbs, and substantial red-brown robes. Preserve his unusual mask, curved golden head ornaments, and circular waist silhouette rather than normal human anatomy. His brass musical horn hangs inactive beside the body, accompanied by several separate golden meeps with simple spirit forms.
art_direction.scene: Place him at the threshold of a towering open star gate, posture still and forward-facing, with three meeps hovering well behind his shoulders. His cloak hangs in strong geometric folds. Directional amber light strikes the pale mask and horn, while deep blue wax-crayon shadow shapes and a far empty landscape create a solemn journey scene without threatening magic.
art_direction.palette: deep russet, mask ivory, antique gold, cosmic blue
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
